candidates.primary_query: cuándo se puede tocar la bocina en vietnam en moto
secondary_queries: prohibido tocar el claxon de noche en vietnam
normas del claxon para motos en vietnam
multa por tocar la bocina en hanói
candidates.intent_rationale: Riders hear constant honking and want to know when the law actually allows the horn, the night-time ban in residential areas and what continuous honking costs.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 21 of Law 36/2024/QH15 (horn only to warn of danger or announce overtaking, no continuous honking, no horn from 22:00 to 05:00 in residential and hospital areas), headlight signalling at night under Article 14(5), and the Decree 168/2024 fines in Article 7(1)(i) and 7(9)(k).
candidates.working_title: La bocina en moto en Vietnam: cuándo está permitida y cuándo no

candidates.intent_rationale: Riders want the actual junction priority rules before riding: main road first, yield to the right where no roundabout sign applies and to the left on signed roundabouts, plus pedestrians when turning.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 22 of Law 36/2024/QH15 and the turning duties of Article 15, then the Decree 168/2024 fines that apply (Article 7(6)(c)-(d) for failing to yield at junctions and roundabouts, 7(5) for turning without yielding to pedestrians and oncoming traffic).

candidates.intent_rationale: Riders want to know on which side Vietnamese law allows overtaking, where it is banned and how to signal it, before riding out of the city.
candidates.content_angle: Explains Article 14 of Law 36/2024/QH15: overtake on the left, on the right only when the vehicle ahead is turning left, the places where overtaking is banned (narrow bridges, blind bends and crests, junctions, rail crossings, pedestrian crossings, tunnels), signalling with lights only at night in towns, and the Decree 168/2024 fines in Article 7(1)(b) and 7(3)(đ).
